item.title: Thai rock icons Potato return to Singapore this August
item.description: One of Thailand’s most iconic rock bands, Potato, will return to Singapore on 22 August, 8PM at SCAPE The Ground Theatre. The one-night-only concert promises a raw, emotional, and unapologetically powerful live set — exactly what Potato have become known for across more than two decades of shaping modern Thai rock. item.title: George Lam & Sally Yeh to bring 'We Are One' world tour concert to Singapore this April
item.description: After nearly three decades, two pillars of Cantopop are finally sharing the stage again. George Lam and Sally Yeh will bring their long-awaited We Are One World Tour to Singapore this 4 April, marking their first major collaboration in 28 years. item.description: Global pop star KUN has officially unveiled his self-titled sophomore album, marking his first full-length release in English — and his debut project with 88rising. item.title: Thee Sacred Souls to make soulful Singapore debut this May as part of 'Live For You Tour 2026'
item.description: American soul and R&B trio Thee Sacred Souls are set to make their Singapore debut this May, bringing their emotionally rich sound to The Capitol Theatre for a one-night-only performance. The band will take the stage on Tuesday, 26 May, marking their first-ever city performance in Singapore. Presented by LAMC, the show promises an evening of raw emotion, soulful harmonies, and timeless R&B, offering local audiences the chance to experience Thee Sacred Souls live for the very first time.
